description: Click an element by ref, as a real mouse click. Returns what changed on the page (a diff: + came, - gone, ~ changed, new text), or the new page after a navigation; refs of what didn't change stay valid. If something covers the element (a cookie dialog, a modal) it says what, with its buttons' refs, and doesn't click. For what the tree can't name (a canvas, a map), x and y instead of ref: a point in the latest screenshot's pixels.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. e12

tab.description: Tab id, as `open` or `tabs` gave it

name: click
title: Click
